name: Keyed expander, hold and fade
desc: Classic keyed expansion plus 20 ms hold and a 60 ms fade: short pauses in staccato riffs stay open, then close clean

refs.why: staccato riffing that wants dead-silent stops between mutes
refs.source: Reverb.com, Misha Mansoor outlines the ultimate metal pedalboard (undated)

notes: The doc's hold / release row, the two extra knobs of the plus version
